verdict.rationale: Qodo's own docs show event-driven automation: reviews run automatically on every pull request, with configuration of whether reviews trigger manually or automatically and when they run (docs-26). Teams can define centralized rules that are enforced automatically across repositories, and Qodo can auto-publish risk labels on PRs. All of this is configurable via portal or .pr_agent.toml. However, it is limited to the PR-review event and its fixed actions, not a general user-defined event→action rule engine. Missing for 10: arbitrary user-defined triggers beyond PR events, custom action definitions (e.g., conditional workflows or outbound actions), detailed docs on trigger conditions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
